name: Nam Can
kicker: Fishing town on the way to the cape
summary: Stop for the fishing boats on the cape road, then ride on to the Đất Mũi gate while it is open. The 58.7 km section to the gate starts at cầu Ông Tình, here. Ask on the bank for a market hour and a boat fare. The sail and the two seas are farther south.
timeNeeded: A stop on the cape road
getThere: South of the city, before the 58.7 km cape section.
heroCaption: Fishing boats along the bank at Năm Căn

notice.title: The cape gate is farther south
notice.body: The 58.7 km Hồ Chí Minh section to Đất Mũi starts at cầu Ông Tình, in this town. The sail and the two seas are past the bridge.

body: The boats sit under the sheds along the canal, and the market is the stop if you are already in town. The commune office is on đường Hùng Vương, khóm 1. Ask on the bank for a market hour and for a boat toward the mangrove.

This section of road ended Ngọc Hiển’s isolation from a car road. Phase 1 was finished in 2016. The alignment is drawn as cấp III đồng bằng, design speed 80 km/h, and the cross-section still matches cấp V, about 40 km/h. Come in the morning so the gate farther south is still open. That gate runs 07:00–18:00.
The marker, the ship panel, and the two seas are past cầu Ông Tình. A stop on this bank is the town on the way.

figures.caption: The market street in Năm Căn
figures.alt: A sunny market street in Nam Can with fruit stalls, motorbikes, and shop houses

gettingThere: Ride south from the city on Quốc lộ 1 to Năm Căn, then the Hồ Chí Minh road. The ride to the town is more than 50 km and more than an hour, then more than 50 km beyond. The measured cape section, 58.7 km, starts at cầu Ông Tình.

legs.heading: From Ca Mau
legs.body: By road on Quốc lộ 1. The ride is more than 50 km and more than an hour. Motorbikes can use this road. They stay off the expressway, which ends at xã Hồ Thị Kỷ.
